deployments_detail.use: AI-powered surgical planning: RI.KNEE ROBOTICS v2.0, CORI Surgical System, RI.INSIGHTS data visualisation; JointVue ultrasound 3D planning

CORI Surgical System — next-generation handheld robotics platform for knee (and hip) arthroplasty that uses AI-driven software across the procedure suite (image-agnostic smart mapping, real-time planning) to deliver robotics-assisted surgery. [Smith+Nephew (Real Intelligence platform)]

Personalized Planning powered by AI on CORI — AI-guided reference values (RI.INSIGHTS) let surgeons set initial implant starting positions personalized to the patient's deformity/anatomy during total knee arthroplasty. [Smith+Nephew]
RI.KNEE ROBOTICS software — uses AI for personalized planning and implant placement; the only robotic-assisted solution indicated for revision total knee arthroplasty in the US. [Smith+Nephew]

RI.HIP NAVIGATION / RI.HIP Modeler — software-only, computer-guided approach to total hip arthroplasty; Modeler performs impingement analysis based on an individual patient profile and assesses pelvic tilt for patient-specific component alignment. [Smith+Nephew]

CORIOGRAPH Pre-Op Planning and Modeling Services — AI/advanced 2D- and 3D-based preoperative planning and personalized modeling; FDA-cleared for total hip arthroplasty (Jan 2025) and launched for total shoulder arthroplasty (Oct 2025). [Smith+Nephew]

TESSA (Tracking Enabled Spatial Surgery Assistant) — spatial surgery system using video processing and augmented-reality guidance, powered by an NVIDIA GPU, to assist surgeons in ACL reconstruction femoral tunnel placement. Submitted to FDA for 510(k) clearance; not yet cleared/deployed. [Smith+Nephew / NVIDIA (GPU)]

Partnership with HOPCo to provide AI-powered analytics and digital-health solutions (HOPCo's Vitals platform: tools, analytics, dashboards, RTM, PROMs) to Smith+Nephew's Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC) customers and physicians. [HOPCo (Healthcare Outcomes Performance Company)]

Smartcat AI translation platform used to translate highly regulated medical content and training courses, cutting translation turnaround time and workload for the global content/localization function. [Smartcat]

Deployment of Applaud's AI-led Employee Experience Solution embedding generative AI in HR Service Delivery — a unified personalized knowledge hub aggregating Workday and ServiceNow to help ~18,000 employees find HR information. [Applaud (with Workday, ServiceNow)]

Partnership/pilot with Proximie's AI-powered digital surgery platform to deliver advanced robotics surgery training and remotely connect operating rooms (UK, Ireland, Nordics), improving surgical training and support. [Proximie]
